# Kinexis Digital

> Kinexis Digital is a growth marketing agency for home services and ecommerce brands. We run SEO, paid media, web design, branding, and content as one program scored on leads and revenue.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/): Agency overview and growth program.
- [Services](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/services): Web design, SEO, branding, paid ads, and content marketing.
- [Industries](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/industries): Markets we serve, with deep pages for home services and ecommerce.
- [Home Services Marketing](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/industries/home-services): Local SEO, conversion pages, and paid media for booked jobs.
- [Ecommerce Marketing](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/industries/ecommerce): Product SEO, conversion, and paid acquisition for orders and margin.
- [Case Studies](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/case-studies): Measured client results across search, paid, and websites.
- [About](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/about): How we work, partnership model, and method.
- [Contact](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/contact): Book a strategy call or send a project inquiry.
- [Blog](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/blog): Practical notes on SEO, paid media, CRO, email, and analytics.
- [Resources](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/resources): Platform docs and tools we use with clients.
- [Clients](https://www.kinexisdigital.com/clients): Brands and platform partners we've worked with.
